versions.changelog:
content-creation-multi-agent v0.1.0

- Initial release of the multi-agent content creation skill package.
- Provides 6 specialized content creation agents for note-taking, social media, e-commerce video, general writing, image sourcing/generation, and Seedance video prompting.
- Supports one-click install, permission auto-configuration, agent selection, and Clawhub sharing.
- Includes collaborative workflows between agents for efficient content production.
